title: Clean Preset Setting Reset and Curated Three-Per-Type Map Example Catalog
selected_by_owner: Owner expressly requested removing all previous example setting groupings and making three demonstrative examples available for every map type. Request follows UX-02 Home/library review and is scoped to standalone HTML, 2026-11-20.

in_scope: Preserve cumulative standalone MMHT-01–15 authoring tools with the UX-02 home-first shell while replacing visible older seed/demo map navigation with a separate curated type-oriented example catalog.

Give all eight foundational/structural starters and all fourteen specialist map purpose choices three valid editable sample documents each (22 type choices, 66 examples), each with actual browser-rendered preview, authored feature-family metadata and a hands-on editor exercise.

Offer family-based browsing with purpose search; opening an example creates its own editable personal draft and leaves catalog assets unchanged; supply 66 independent portable editable JSON drafts and 66 thumbnails.

One-time clear existing preset/user setting grouping labels and old location assignments from UX-02 organization metadata in the current browser origin, with local metadata recovery copy, without modifying/deleting personal map documents.
Exclude old built-in demonstration records from visible My maps and example browsing without destructive removal of required internal authoring seeds; retain manually archived personal maps.

Sanitize invalid optional null source fields in curated copies; include alternately rotated actual geometry where earlier templates were duplicates; apply Rainbow in the Dark map-first responsive navigation.
boundaries: Illustrative maps are derived from previously implemented native map data, not 66 wholly independent newly illustrated worlds; some map-type categories reuse an underlying reference site while highlighting different specialist layers.
No authoring engine schema rewrite, canonical world/Reality/travel change, GM permission grant, ecological/mining/farming simulation, native game integration or campaign creation.

Browser localStorage is origin-scoped; one-time organizational reset can only affect data visible to this HTML URL. Personal map documents are not deleted or silently migrated across Android content:// origins.
Chromium desktop and mobile-width proof is not physical Android or Unity acceptance; browser-valid sample geometry and screenshots do not guarantee perfect visual art direction on every device.

evidence.validation: All 66/66 curated examples passed the actual native standalone HTML `documentError` after an editable copy was created using original newMapDocument/addMap. All 66 JSON draft files and 66 WebP thumbnails were generated by opening the actual editor and capturing its map canvas; zero browser page errors in full batch. Browser desktop 1280×900 and mobile-like 390×844 confirmed Home, grouped/family-filtered catalog, search, exactly three examples per category, valid editable copy, return to Home, no horizontal overflow or JS page errors. A saved UX-02 personal cave under a prior setting was carried into a fresh UX-03 page; setting and nested collection labels were cleared once and recovery metadata stored, while map ID/document remained valid. Old built-in reference maps did not appear in My maps or My archive. One native full editable JSON draft imported through the original browser file input and validated. ZIP integrity/154 files and hashes inspected. Source-derived examples share geometry where appropriate; no physical Android/Unity or art approval.
